_comment: Intrepid's checklists, condensed from Apollo 11's (data/missions/apollo_11/lm_checklists.json) for Apollo 12's flight: DOI, powered descent with the ground's landing site update (Noun 69) and the redesignation onto the Surveyor crater, the surface stay, the liftoff and the rendezvous [adapted for this simulator]. Keys as in checklists.json: V/N/Enter = VERB/NOUN/ENTR, Space = PRO; the switches are on Intrepid's HUD and in its cabin, and the PAD buttons on the HUD and the wrist menu. control: the cabin control a step is done on (an id in data/cockpit/lm_controls.csv); without it the checklist highlight finds the control that writes the step's check channel. phases: the flight phases (mission.phase) a checklist is for; it opens as the commander boards in one. LGC MODE FREE between burns.

steps.text: Yankee Clipper: CMC MODE - FREE, then UNDOCK on GO for undocking
LGC MODE - FREE: drift to DOI
Mission Control: the DOI PAD (UPLINK ACTY), or DOI to ask for it
V37E 30E - P30 External Delta-V
Verify TIG (N33), PRO; verify N81 DV, PRO; check N42, PRO
Houston: GO for DOI
LGC MODE - AUTO
V37E 40E - P40 DPS Thrusting, TIG-15 min
V50N18 flashing: PRO to maneuver to burn attitude
ENG ARM - DES
At TIG-5 s V99N40 flashing: PRO for engine on
Monitor V16N40 (TFI, VG, DV) - DPS cutoff
ENG ARM - OFF
Trim N85 residuals with the TTCA, then PRO
LGC MODE - FREE: drift to PDI
Mission Control: the PDI PAD and a state vector (UPLINK ACTY)
V37E 63E - P63 Braking, TIG-10 min
Verify TIG (V06N33), PRO
LGC MODE - AUTO
V50N18 flashing: PRO to maneuver to the PDI attitude
ENG ARM - DES
Houston: GO for powered descent
At TIG-5 s V99N68 flashing: PRO for ignition
Houston: Noun 69, the site's move downrange; V21N69E, R1 as read (+/-, ft), E
V57E: landing radar updates (ALT and VEL lights out)
High gate: P64, the LPD on the window (V16N64): redesignate onto the Surveyor crater
P65 lands, or ROD clicks fly P66, to CONTACT LIGHT
Touchdown: P68 (V06N43)
ENG ARM - OFF
PRO: P00
Houston: STAY for T1
Houston: STAY for T3
Mission Control: the ascent PAD and Yankee Clipper's state vector (UPLINK ACTY)
V37E 12E - P12 Powered Ascent
Verify TIG (V06N33), PRO
Verify targets and crossrange (V06N76), PRO
LGC MODE - AUTO
Houston: go to cast off on this rev
At TIG-5 s V99N74 flashing: ABORT STAGE
ENG ARM - ASC
PRO: liftoff
Monitor V16N94 to insertion, V16N85
ENG ARM - OFF
PRO: P00
LGC MODE - FREE: drift to CSI

checklists.title: Rendezvous and docking (P20, P32 to P35)

steps.text: Mission Control: the CSI PAD and Yankee Clipper's state vector (UPLINK ACTY)
V37E 20E - P20 Rendezvous navigation: radar marks (V16N54)
V37E 32E - P32 CSI, TIG-25 min: PRO on N11, N55 and N37; check N75, PRO; N81, PRO
LGC MODE - AUTO; V37E 41E - P41 RCS Thrusting, TIG-10 min
V50N18: PRO to maneuver; at TIG-5 s V99N40: PRO; cutoff V16N85
Trim N85 residuals with the TTCA, then PRO
LGC MODE - FREE: drift to CDH
V37E 33E - P33 CDH, TIG-20 min: PRO on N13; check N75, PRO; N81, PRO
LGC MODE - AUTO; V37E 41E - P41 RCS Thrusting, TIG-10 min
V50N18: PRO to maneuver; at TIG-5 s V99N40: PRO; cutoff V16N85
Trim N85 residuals with the TTCA, then PRO
LGC MODE - FREE: drift to TPI
V37E 34E - P34 TPI, TIG-30 min: PRO on N55; check N37, PRO; N58, PRO; N81, PRO
LGC MODE - AUTO; V37E 41E - P41 RCS Thrusting, TIG-10 min
V50N18: PRO to maneuver; at TIG-5 s V99N40: PRO; cutoff V16N85
Trim N85 residuals with the TTCA, then PRO
LGC MODE - FREE: drift to the first midcourse
V37E 35E - P35 first midcourse, 5 min ahead: check N81, PRO
LGC MODE - AUTO; V37E 41E - P41; V50N18 PRO; V99N40 PRO; cutoff V16N85
Trim N85 residuals with the TTCA, then PRO
LGC MODE - FREE: drift to the second midcourse
V37E 35E - P35 second midcourse, 5 min ahead: check N81, PRO
LGC MODE - AUTO; V37E 41E - P41; V50N18 PRO; V99N40 PRO; cutoff V16N85
Trim N85 residuals with the TTCA, then PRO; LGC MODE stays AUTO for the braking
Braking by the gates on the TTCA: stop 40 m from Yankee Clipper
Face Yankee Clipper with Intrepid's +X; L: Yankee Clipper docks
